headline: Brazil Central Bank Expected to Cut Selic Rate as Fiscal Focus Persists
summary: Brazil's Copom is expected to cut the Selic rate, though future December reductions remain contingent on fiscal evolution, the exchange rate, and inflation expectations.
why: Policy rate decisions by the central bank directly influence domestic borrowing costs, currency exchange rates, and fixed-income yields in Brazil.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: A change in the Selic policy rate alters domestic interest rates and economic liquidity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Anticipation of monetary policy easing shifts yield curve pricing and alters capital flows across Brazilian fixed income and equity markets.
